1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutEdgeRouteBranches
2 
3 /-! Tree vertices and closed tree edges as points and paths on the actual boundary. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutLocusTree
6 
7 open Set
8 
9 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
10 
11 /-- A graph vertex regarded as its actual surface point. -/
12 def vertexTarget (u : T.vertices) : frontier P.body :=
13   ⟨u, P.cutSetInSpace_subset_boundary a (T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.vertex_in_trace u)⟩
14 
15 theorem vertexTarget_cut (u : T.vertices) : T.vertexTarget u ∈ P.cutSet a :=
16   (P.mem_cutSetInSpace a _).mp (T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.vertex_in_trace u)
17 
18 theorem vertexTarget_different (u : T.vertices) : a ≠ T.vertexTarget u := by
19   intro same
20   have cut := T.vertexTarget_cut u
21   rw [← same] at cut
22   exact P.source_not_cutSet a cut
23 
24 /-- The affine parametrization of a closed cut-tree edge, including its endpoints. -/
25 noncomputable def closedEdgeTarget {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
26     C(unitInterval, frontier P.body) :=
27   ⟨fun t => ⟨T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.edgePath edge t,
28     P.cutSetInSpace_subset_boundary a (T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.edgePath edge t).property⟩,
29     (continuous_subtype_val.comp (T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.edgePath edge).continuous).subtype_mk _⟩
30 
31 theorem closedEdgeTarget_zero {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
32     T.closedEdgeTarget edge 0 = T.vertexTarget u := by
33   apply Subtype.ext
34   exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_zero _ _
35 
36 theorem closedEdgeTarget_one {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
37     T.closedEdgeTarget edge 1 = T.vertexTarget v := by
38   apply Subtype.ext
39   exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one _ _
40 
41 theorem closedEdgeTarget_interior {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (t : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
42     T.closedEdgeTarget edge ⟨t, t.property.1.le, t.property.2.le⟩ = T.openEdgeTarget edge t := rfl
43 
44 theorem closedEdgeTarget_cut {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (t : unitInterval) :
45     T.closedEdgeTarget edge t ∈ P.cutSet a :=
46   (P.mem_cutSetInSpace a _).mp (T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.edgePath edge t).property
47 
48 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutLocusTree
